readout_other: arousal behaviour score and righting reflex under isoflurane; c-Fos immunofluorescence in target and A1; auditory brainstem response; FDTD elastic wave simulation of skull propagation
direction_notes: US of VTA or M1 raised arousal scores and c-Fos+ counts in the target, also in cochlea-ablated mice; the uncoupled (no gel) group did not show arousal, although A1 c-Fos rose in intact mice in that group.

timing.protocol_description: Pulse repetition frequency 500 kHz (as written), pulse duration 1 ms, duty cycle 50%, sonication duration 1 s, interstimulus interval 2 s; stimulation delivered until righting reflex or for up to 30 min under 0.7%-0.8% isoflurane.
